hook: Russia hides places you were never supposed to see. Here are seven.
jeannette: Jeannette Island, in the Arctic. For years, online maps showed it as a solid black shape. No one explained why.
patomskiy: Patomskiy Crater. A strange cone of broken rock in the Siberian forest. Locals call it the Fire Eagle's Nest, and stay away.
yamal: Yamal. In 2014, the frozen ground here simply exploded, leaving giant holes. Trapped methane gas is the main suspect.
kola: The Kola Superdeep Borehole. Twelve kilometres down, the deepest hole ever dug. Today, it is sealed with a rusty metal cap.
lenin: Near Omsk, pine trees spell out the word Lenin, each letter about eighty metres tall. You can only read it from the sky.
batagaika: Batagaika, the gateway to the underworld. A crater almost one kilometre wide, and it grows every single year.
yamantau: Mount Yamantau. A closed military town sits at its foot, and many believe a huge bunker is hidden inside the mountain.
end: Which one would you visit? Tell me in the comments.
